time_period.nocturnal_window: 02:13 AM (Unattended autonomous cron and CI/CD remediation window)
time_period.diurnal_window: Dawn to mid-day operational shifts and enterprise monitoring

weather.datacenter_interior: Strict climate-controlled HVAC cleanroom environment (18°C, 45% humidity), sterile airflow
weather.exterior_environment: Overcast rainy night transitioning to pale overcast dawn daylight

lighting.sources: Terminal phosphor glow (green/cyan), 5000K overhead industrial fluorescent strips at 20% night-cycle, 480nm cyan telemetry LEDs, 3200K tungsten task lamps, natural dusk/dawn window light

camera_language.style: Disciplined investigative cinema (David Fincher / Laura Poitras emulation)
camera_language.lenses: 35mm and 50mm anamorphic cinema primes, controlled shallow depth of field (f/1.8 to f/4.0)
camera_language.motion_rules: Deliberate motivated camera movement only: slow forward dolly for increasing tension, locked-off static for analytical authority, smooth crane for spatial scale; zero arbitrary handheld jitter

visual_style.color_grading: Cool industrial shadow palette (#0B0F19, #1F2937) punctuated by sharp practical emitters (#00FF66 terminal phosphor, #00D4FF telemetry cyan, #F59E0B alert amber)
visual_style.pacing_rhythm: Rapid cognitive cuts for multi-agent RPC loops, deliberate expansive shots for architectural scale

clothing.daniel_mercer: Navy fleece vest over rolled-up gray Oxford shirt, rectangular titanium wire-rim spectacles

technology.runtime_environment: Linux kernel cgroups, unshare namespaces, Docker/Kata microVM sandboxes
technology.hardware_security: Titanium biometric YubiKeys, PDU industrial keylock switches

visual_rules: No fantasy sci-fi or cyberpunk neon cliches
Motivated lighting only (screen glow, fluorescent utility, status LEDs, natural daylight/dusk)
Aspect ratio 16:9, anamorphic 35mm / 50mm cinema prime emulation
Pacing matches cognitive intensity: rapid for execution loops, slow for architectural scale
Max 2 consecutive shots of any visual archetype (QA strict compliance rule)
